Folded glass in the corner and blue numbered directory on a pale ground.
Glass download cloud on left, blue numeral and chapter title on right.
Centered masthead followed by wide horizontal explanatory passages.
Chapter repeats cloud and circular pale corner language.
Alternating blue and pale rounded panels; panel repetition alone is insufficient for the expanded deck.
Blue outline prose panels alternate with two wide laptop photographs.
Disc repeats cover; expanded closing instead places cloud above a wide closing line.

cover.designReason: Large disc at right with bold left display and a short source subtitle.

toc.designReason: Glass fold anchors an open masthead; two numbered original chapter entries sit in wide stacked rows.

chapter.designReason: Cloud left, original chapter number above the full chapter title at right; shared across chapter roles.

ending.designReason: Small centered cloud precedes a wide closing statement and source text below.

content.designReason: A long left article reads beside a cloud exhibit, with the masthead above both.

visualAcceptance.scope: Complete 30-slide visual coverage: all changed PNGs re-inspected at full size, unchanged PNGs independently SHA-verified byte-identical to previously fully inspected pages; new complete reference/deck contact sheet inspected for nonadjacent and cross-role principal composition comparisons. Only same-role chapters exempt.
limitations: Isolated actual HTTP export only; not deployment acceptance.
